_comment: What the study nights are working through. Harold sets the book here, from the admin page, whenever the room starts a new one. Leave number null: the 2pm Discord post reads the chapter out of the most recent study recap, so there is no second number to keep up to date. Setting a number here overrides the recap. "finished" is the date the room completed the book: until a new book is chosen (which resets "started"), study night posts stop naming it.
